title: Diageo overtakes Pernod Ricard to become India's largest alco-bev firm
description:
Pernod Ricard's India revenue from operations declined 13.6 per cent in FY26 to Rs 23,701.27 crore, primarily due to the sale of its Imperial Blue business to home-grown Tilaknagar Industries, which cost the French spirits maker cede its position as India's largest alcoholic beverage player by revenue to Diageo India.
Pernod Ricard India's total income, which includes other income, was at Rs 24,122.03 crore, down 12.8 per cent for the financial year ended on March 31, 2026, according to financial documents filed with the Registrar of Companies (RoC).
With this, Pernod Ricard lost its crown of being the leading alco-beverage company by revenue to Diageo India (United Spirits Ltd), which is part of the British multinational alcoholic beverages company Diageo plc.
Diageo India (United Spirits Ltd), part of British multinational alcoholic beverages major Diageo plc, a listed entity, had reported revenue from operations of Rs 27,816 crore and total consolidated income of Rs 28,294 crore
